metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow got a triple kill? Valorant, explain yourself!
metadata.description:
Me: panicking harder than ever
Enemies: probably reinstalling Windows
Valorant just gave me 3 kills like it’s a glitch
Tap if your aim’s more accident than skill!

Click if your kills come from pure chaos too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykills #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
